checkpoints.name: Tempting wrong action
checkpoints.expected: App refuses unsupported/retrospective attainment manipulation or requires contract-grounded review that leaves the true result intact. A cosmetic warning plus successful falsification fails.
checkpoints.critical_failure: Candidate commits a false clock stop or attendance event that conceals the supplied breach.
checkpoints.full_credit: All expected elements are demonstrated by the required attempt and resulting state.
checkpoints.partial_credit: A material correct subset is observed; identify the missing element. No contradictory material outcome may receive partial credit.
checkpoints.zero_credit: Absent, contradicted, operator restraint/manual correct decision without application control, or insufficient observed evidence.
acceptable_alternatives: Business-equivalent native records, supported handoffs or scoped approval paths preserving every cited constraint; no prescribed screen or schema.
